notes.title: Season Pass and Digital Deluxe Version Update
notes.content: [p]Due to technical difficulties, the distribution of the Trails in the Sky 1st Chapter Season Pass and Digital Deluxe Edition containing the Season Pass have been delayed. We are working hard to release this content as soon as possible and will keep the community updated as more information is known. [/p][p]Thank you for your patience and continued support.[/p]

notes.title: Trails in the Sky 1st Chapter English Voice Cast Announcement!
notes.content:
[h1]We're excited to share this 1st look at the English voice cast for Trails in the Sky 1st Chapter! ✨
[/h1]

[previewyoutube=nYiKVR3TNp8;full][/previewyoutube]


[h3]Starting with our energetic protagonist [b]Estelle Bright[/b], reprised by Stephanie Sheh! ☀️
[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45361324/f1857fec093c00cd65413d4b88963bdbd178a587.png[/img]


[h3]Our intelligent and level-headed protagonist, [b]Joshua Bright[/b], will be reprised by Johnny Yong Bosch! 🌑[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45361324/11e0cc9f9d7ddb5a2f55b339e8efdfd4c6fb711a.png[/img]


[h3]The seasoned mentor known as "The Silver Flash", [b]Scherazard Harvey[/b], will be voiced again by Michelle Ruff! 💥[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45361324/faf2de41b4a6b57576067c0865c000ece279d3bc.png[/img]


[h3]Give it up for the insightful yet carefree traveling bard, [b]Olivier Lenheim[/b], with Matthew Mercer returning to the role! 🌹[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45361324/6eb1b1eccf3a247980f87c83b190e6153f64fb18.png[/img]


[h3][b]Kloe Rinz[/b], beloved for her gentle and kind nature, will be reprised by Cristina Vee! 💜🪶
[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45361324/1ba8bd3f59f6c262bd753cae3796fb3b86b6a719.png[/img]


[h3]Though he can be harsh at times, the undeniably skilled "Heavy Blade" [b]Agate Crosner[/b] will be voiced once again by Ben Pronsky! ⚔️[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45361324/3e56f687899cd5796736162bddcb5ba7906a33fe.png[/img]


[h3]Everyone give some love to the ever-sweet [b]Tita Russell[/b], with Brianna Knickerbocker reprising her role! 🔧[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45361324/4693c48c426a5b4bfca3a4a4e6d51b0fe3ad0010.png[/img]


[h3]A martial artist from the Calvard Republic, "The Immovable" [b]Zin Vathek[/b] will be reprised by Vic Chao! 💪
[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45361324/ca1d6cdd6801b1c2d35305f0eb6f5b31c04a9ac3.png[/img]
